content.title: How to watch 'Euphoria' season 3 online from anywhere
content.text: Rue (Zendaya) is on the run from Mexican drug dealers, Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) is an adult content creator shacked up in a dream home with Nate (Jacob Elordi), and Jules (Hunter Schafer) is at art school and moonlighting as a sugar baby in "Euphoria" season 3.The premiere, titled "Ándale", air tonight, four years since its last outing. The likely final season both sounds and looks (scroll down for the trailer) like an entirely different show — and deliberately so, too. The angsty teen drama has always had a tenuous relationship with reality, the line between plot and steamy, depraved fantasy being blurred to the extreme, but creator Sam Levinson has decided that continuing to depict Zendaya (29), Sweeney (28), Elordi (28) and Schafer (27) as high-school kids has finally run its course.Furthermore, the untimely death of Angus Cloud, whose character Fezco O'Neill was at the heart of the S2 cliffhanger, and delays caused by the 2023 SAG-AFTRA strike and scheduling conflicts, for instance with "The Idol", forced a change in direction. However, the central premise remains the same: is Rue a careless person with flaws, or is she actively evil?The hedonistic "Euphoria" maxim of just wanting to party, and all the better if someone else is footing the bill, rings hollow if there are no real consequences, and S3 has a sense of chickens coming home to roost. When even Ali (Colman Domingo) has had his fill of Rue's antics, that's when you know she's really pushed things too far.Read on as we explain how to watch "Euphoria" season 3 online from anywhere. How to watch 'Euphoria' S3 in the U.S. (Image credit: Shutterstock) In the U.S., "Euphoria" season 3 airs on HBO at 9 p.m. ET/PT each Sunday, starting April 12,for eight weeks.HBO is a broadcast network that can be accessed with one of the best TV antennas, a cable TV package or a live TV streaming platform like YouTube TV.YouTube TV comes with a 10-day FREE trial, after which you can get $15 off each your first three months for a limited time. A subscription usually costs $82.99/month."Euphoria" S3 is also available to stream, either live as it airs or on-demand, on HBO Max.HBO Max prices start at $10.99/month if you don't mind ads. For better value, you can pay for a whole year upfront and effectively get 12 months for the price of 10 on any of its tiers.HBO can also be added to OTT streaming services such as Hulu, Amazon Prime Video and Disney Plus.Sling TV, Fubo and Hulu with Live TV also carry HBO.Traveling abroad and don't want to miss the show? Don't worry, you can still access your usual streamer via a VPN. We recommend NordVPN. How to watch 'Euphoria' S3 from anywhere Away from home at the moment and blocked from watching "Euphoria" season 3 on your preferred service?You can still tune in as normal thanks to the wonders of a VPN (Virtual Private Network). The software allows your devices to appear as if they're back in your home country regardless of where in the world you are. Ideal for viewers away on vacation or on business. Our favorite is NordVPN. It's the best on the market: Using a VPN is incredibly simple.1. Install the VPN of your choice. As we've said, NordVPN is our favorite.2. Choose the location you wish to connect to in the VPN app. For instance, if you're visiting the U.K. and want to view a U.S. service, select 'United States' from the list.3. Sit back and enjoy the show. Head to HBO Max, sign in, and watch "Euphoria" season 3. How to watch 'Euphoria' S3 in Canada (Image credit: Shutterstock) Crave is home to "Euphoria" season 3 in Canada, with episodes landing at 9 p.m. ET/PT each Sunday, from April 12. Prices start at CA$11.99/month or CA$119.99/year.Outside Canada when it's on? Use a VPN to get around the geo-restrictions that will prevent Crave from working. How to watch 'Euphoria' S3 in the U.K. (Image credit: Shutterstock) In the U.K., "Euphoria" season 3 premieres at 2 a.m. BST on Monday, April 13 on Sky Atlantic and Now. It will air again later that day at 9 p.m.Sky Atlantic is also available to watch via Sky Essential TV (Sky's most basic bundle includes Sky Atlantic, Discovery+ and Netflix Standard with Ads), for £15 per month.Sky subscribers can also stream the show via the Sky Go app, which is available on smartphones, computers, games consoles and a host of TV streaming devices.You can also stream "Euphoria" season 3 on the newly launched U.K. version of HBO Max. Subscriptions start at just £5.99 a month.Abroad? Don't panic. You'll need one of the best VPNs to use Sky Go, Now or HBO Max, which will otherwise be geo-blocked. We recommend NordVPN. How to watch 'Euphoria' S3 in Australia (Image credit: Shutterstock) "Euphoria" season 3 is available to watch on HBO Max in Australia, with episodes landing each Monday, starting April 13.Prices start from AU$11.99/month, AU$119.99/year.If you're not home in Australia right now, you can still catch the show by using a VPN, such as NordVPN.
